استنفرن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْفَرْنَ (istanfarna) /is.tan.far.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
# اُسْتُنْفِرْنَ (ustunfirna) /us.tun.fir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
# اِسْتَنْفِرْنَ (istanfirna) /is.tan.fir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
